full_judgment: 8. Mr Faruque Ahmed, learned Advocate for the respondents, submitted that as the stipulated period for performance did not expire on 6-5-92 institution of the suit was correctly held by the Subordinate Judge to be premature and the plaintiffs had no cause of action to sue and the learned Subordinate Judge rightly rejected the plaint. In support he cited AIR 1950 Cal 207 and AIR 1918 Mad 272.
